headline: Superintendent introduced Michaek Kulak as recommended candidate for Greene-Hills School assistant principal; no vote recorded.
summary: The superintendent introduced Michaek Kulak, whom she will recommend for assistant principal of Greene-Hills School. Questions and discussion followed the introduction. The minutes do not record a vote.
